moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins next week, with the first fixture scheduled for Friday, August 21st.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Football's back! The Premier League season kicks off next Friday with Arsenal taking on Coventry City. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive weekend of football! The Premier League returns with Hull vs Man Utd on Saturday and more action on Sunday. What match are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 Launch Date Revealed
moments.blurb: The launch show for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 is set to be pre-recorded on September 9th and broadcast on Saturday, September 19th, with live shows commencing the following week.

angles.name: Build-up Excitement
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! The launch date for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 has been revealed for September 19th. Who do you want to see lift the Glitterball trophy this year?

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe and Josh Widdicombe are set to host the new series of Strictly. Are you ready for the new era of ballroom glamour?
